svg.title: \underbrace{\sum_{j=1}^{p}\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n} x_{ij}^{2}}_{\text{Var. of data}} = \underbrace{\sum_{m=1}^{M}\frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n} z_{im}^{2}}_{\text{Var. of first } M \text{ PCs}} + \underbrace{\frac{1}{n}\sum_{j=1}^{p}\sum_{i=1}^{n}\left(x_{ij} - \sum_{m=1}^{M} z_{im}\phi_{jm}\right)^{2}}_{\text{MSE of } M\text{-dimensional approximation}}
